_doc: Apps you can connect from the Apps tab. Each is a remote MCP server. auth: oauth (sign in with the app; MCP OAuth with dynamic client registration), google (sign in with your own Google OAuth client), token (paste a key), none (nothing to sign in to). mode: default for new connections, read (only tools that look things up) or ask (changes need your approval). safe_tools / external_tools are glob patterns over the app's tool names; anything that reaches other people is refused for every app regardless (see apps.reaches_people). inspect_args: the app runs other apps' actions through one tool, so the arguments are checked too. Endpoints checked against vendor docs and github.com/jaw9c/awesome-remote-mcp-servers, October 2026. native: a built-in Riki tool the app switches on, instead of an MCP server (the key stays with the app).
_roles: What people mostly use Riki for, picked during setup: the apps worth connecting first, starter requests for Home, and the check-in list (it only runs if you turn check-ins on).

roles.label: Building software
roles.blurb: Code, pull requests, deploys and bugs
prompts: What needs me on GitHub today?
What broke in Sentry this week?
Plan my coding day around my calendar
roles.checkin: Check my open pull requests, failed deploys and new errors. Tell me only what needs me today, in 1-3 short bullets.

roles.label: Money and investing
prompts: How did my portfolio do this week?
Find this month's bills and invoices in my mail
Explain the biggest move in my holdings
roles.checkin: Look at my holdings and any bills or payment mails due soon. Tell me only what needs me today, in 1-3 short bullets.

roles.label: Running a team or business
prompts: What's on my plate this week?
Which emails am I late replying to?
Prep me for my next meeting
roles.checkin: Look at today's meetings, important mail I haven't answered and overdue tasks. Tell me what needs me, in 1-3 short bullets.

roles.label: Studying
prompts: Make me a study plan for this week
Quiz me on what I studied last
Turn my notes into a one-page summary
roles.checkin: Look at deadlines and classes coming up. Tell me what to focus on today, in 1-3 short bullets.

roles.label: Everyday life
roles.checkin: Look at my day and anything time-sensitive in my mail. Tell me only what matters, in 1-3 short bullets.
